notes: Forked from 2026.09.04. Scope 2 electricity recorded as dual reporting: the framework requires both the location-based and market-based figures, so neither is a preference over the other.

activityCategory.label: Activity Category
activityCategory.dict: Selects which governed decision table the engine loads. Drives everything downstream.

activityType.label: Activity Type / Template
activityType.dict: Data-entry template within a category. Narrows the expected inputs; does not change rule priority.

assetType.label: Asset Type
assetType.dict: Class of leased or operated asset.

contractualInstrument.label: Contractual Instrument
contractualInstrument.dict: Energy attribute certificate or contract backing the electricity claim. Required by every market-based rule.

country.label: Country
country.dict: Geography of the activity. Used by rules that require a country-resolved dataset.

currency.label: Currency
currency.dict: ISO currency of the spend value. A spend without a currency cannot be matched.

distance.label: Distance
distance.dict: Measured or booked travel distance for the activity.

distanceUnit.label: Distance Unit
distanceUnit.dict: Unit of the distance value. Must be a distance dimension.

employeeCount.label: Employee Count
employeeCount.dict: Headcount in scope for the activity. Supports average-data rules only.

energyConsumption.label: Energy Consumption
energyConsumption.dict: Metered energy delivered to the reporting boundary.

energyPerUse.label: Energy per Use (kWh)
energyPerUse.dict: Measured energy drawn by the product in one use cycle.

energyUnit.label: Energy Unit
energyUnit.dict: Unit of the energy value. Must be an energy dimension.

equipmentCharge.label: Equipment Charge Capacity (kg)
equipmentCharge.dict: Nameplate refrigerant charge of the installed equipment.

equipmentType.label: Equipment Type
equipmentType.dict: Equipment class, used to select a governed default leak rate.

equipmentUnits.label: Units of Equipment
equipmentUnits.dict: Count of installed units. Supports the simplified screening rule only.

floorArea.label: Floor Area
floorArea.dict: Gross internal area of the asset. Supports floor-area average-data rules.

freightMass.label: Shipment Weight
freightMass.dict: Gross mass of goods moved. Combined with distance it yields tonne-kilometres.

fuelQuantity.label: Fuel Quantity
fuelQuantity.dict: Volume or mass of fuel purchased or combusted in the period.

fuelType.label: Fuel Type
fuelType.dict: Fuel product combusted. Without it a fuel quantity cannot be resolved to a methodology.

fuelUnit.label: Fuel Unit
fuelUnit.dict: Unit of the fuel quantity. Must be a volume, mass or energy dimension.

gridRegion.label: Grid Region
gridRegion.dict: Grid balancing area the electricity was drawn from. Required by every location-based rule.

investeeEmissions.label: Investee Emissions (tCO₂e)
investeeEmissions.dict: Reported Scope 1+2 of the investee. The only primary-data input for Category 15.

investeeRevenue.label: Investee Revenue
investeeRevenue.dict: Investee turnover, used to allocate sector-average intensity.

investmentValue.label: Investment Value
investmentValue.dict: Carrying value of the equity or debt investment.

leakRate.label: Assumed Leak Rate (%)
leakRate.dict: Governed annual leakage assumption for the equipment class, 0-100%.

massUnit.label: Weight Unit
massUnit.dict: Unit of a mass value. Must be a mass dimension.

materialMass.label: Quantity Purchased
materialMass.dict: Physical quantity of goods purchased, in mass units.

materialType.label: Material / Product Type
materialType.dict: Material classification used to resolve a mass-based average dataset.

mode.label: Mode
mode.dict: Transport mode. Determines which distance-based dataset family applies.

nights.label: Room Nights
nights.dict: Occupied room nights. Primary input for accommodation average-data rules.

ownershipShare.label: Ownership Share (%)
ownershipShare.dict: Reporting company share of the investee, 0-100%.

processInput.label: Raw Material Input (tonne)
processInput.dict: Mass of carbonate or feedstock entering the process.

processOutput.label: Process Output (tonne)
processOutput.dict: Mass of product leaving the industrial process in the period.

processingEnergy.label: Downstream Processing Energy (kWh)
processingEnergy.dict: Energy consumed by the customer to process the intermediate product sold.

productType.label: Product Type
productType.dict: Product class, used to resolve average use-phase or end-of-life datasets.

refrigerantRecharge.label: Quantity Recharged (kg)
refrigerantRecharge.dict: Refrigerant added during servicing in the period. The observed term in a material balance.

refrigerantType.label: Refrigerant Type
refrigerantType.dict: Refrigerant gas in the equipment. Required by every fugitive-emission rule.

region.label: Region / State
region.dict: Sub-national location. Informational unless a rule names it explicitly.

reportingYear.label: Reporting Year
reportingYear.dict: Inventory year the record belongs to. Must fall inside the open reporting window.

sectorCode.label: EEIO Sector
sectorCode.dict: Environmentally-extended input-output sector used to interpret a spend value.

spend.label: Spend
spend.dict: Procurement value of the activity, net of taxes. Lowest-priority input in every table that accepts it.

steamSource.label: Supplier Emission Rate
steamSource.dict: Basis on which the steam, heat or cooling supplier reports its emission intensity.

supplierData.label: Supplier Data
supplierData.dict: Primary data received from the supplier. Outranks every generic dataset when present.

treatmentMethod.label: Treatment Method
treatmentMethod.dict: Disposal or recovery route applied to the waste stream.

unitsSold.label: Units Sold
unitsSold.dict: Count of products sold in the reporting period.

usesPerLifetime.label: Uses per Lifetime
usesPerLifetime.dict: Governed assumption for total use cycles over the product lifetime.

wasteQuantity.label: Waste Quantity
wasteQuantity.dict: Mass or volume of waste transferred off site.

wasteType.label: Waste Type
wasteType.dict: Waste stream composition. Required for the waste-type-specific methodology.

waterService.label: Water Service
waterService.dict: Which municipal service the volume relates to. Supply and treatment carry different datasets.

waterVolume.label: Water Volume
waterVolume.dict: Volume of water supplied to or discharged from the boundary.

workingDays.label: Working Days
workingDays.dict: Commuting days in the period. Optional refinement on distance-based commuting.

ASSET_SPEC.name: Asset-specific
ASSET_SPEC.blurb: Uses metered energy for the specific asset.

AVG_DATA.name: Average-data
AVG_DATA.blurb: Applies a governed average intensity to a physical activity driver.
AVG_DATA.source_ref: Policy and Action Standard Table 8.5, p.85

AVG_MASS.name: Average-data (mass)
AVG_MASS.blurb: Applies a material cradle-to-gate factor to physical quantity.
AVG_MASS.source_ref: Policy and Action Standard Table 8.6, p.87

DIST_BASED.name: Distance-based
DIST_BASED.blurb: Applies a mode-specific factor to measured distance.

ECON_ALLOC.name: Economic allocation
ECON_ALLOC.blurb: Allocates sector-average intensity by revenue share.

EEIO.name: Spend-based (EEIO)
EEIO.blurb: Applies an input-output sector intensity to spend.

ENERGY_CONTENT.name: Energy-content-based
ENERGY_CONTENT.blurb: Converts fuel to energy content before applying a factor.

FLOOR_AREA.name: Floor-area based
FLOOR_AREA.blurb: Applies an asset-class intensity per unit floor area.
FLOOR_AREA.source_ref: Policy and Action Standard Table 8.6, p.87

FUEL_BASED.name: Fuel-based
FUEL_BASED.blurb: Applies a fuel-specific factor to metered fuel quantity.

INSUFFICIENT.name: Insufficient Data
INSUFFICIENT.blurb: No governed rule was satisfied. The engine stops rather than assume.

INVEST_SPEC.name: Investment-specific
INVEST_SPEC.blurb: Allocates reported investee emissions by ownership share.

LOC_BASED.name: Location-based
LOC_BASED.blurb: Applies the average grid intensity of the balancing area.

MAT_BALANCE.name: Material-balance
MAT_BALANCE.blurb: Derives fugitive loss from refrigerant actually recharged.

MKT_BASED.name: Market-based
MKT_BASED.blurb: Applies the intensity of the contractual instrument claimed.

NIGHT_BASED.name: Night-based (average data)
NIGHT_BASED.blurb: Applies a country average per occupied room night.

PROC_MASS.name: Process mass-balance
PROC_MASS.blurb: Derives process emissions from output mass and process chemistry.

PROC_STOICH.name: Stoichiometric (input-based)
PROC_STOICH.blurb: Derives process emissions from carbonate or feedstock input.

SCREEN_LEAK.name: Screening (leak-rate)
SCREEN_LEAK.blurb: Applies a governed leak rate to installed charge.

SCREEN_SIMPLE.name: Simplified screening
SCREEN_SIMPLE.blurb: Applies a default charge and leak rate per equipment unit.
SCREEN_SIMPLE.source_ref: Policy and Action Standard Table 8.5, p.85

SITE_PROC.name: Site-specific processing
SITE_PROC.blurb: Uses customer-reported energy to process the intermediate product.

SPEND_BASED.name: Spend-based
SPEND_BASED.blurb: Applies a monetary intensity to procurement value. Screening quality only.

SUPPLIER_SPEC.name: Supplier-specific
SUPPLIER_SPEC.blurb: Uses primary data reported by the supplier for the purchased item.

TD_LOSS.name: T&D loss-based
TD_LOSS.blurb: Applies grid transmission and distribution loss rates to energy imported.

USE_DIRECT.name: Direct use-phase
USE_DIRECT.blurb: Models lifetime energy of sold products against a grid intensity.

USE_FUEL.name: Use-phase fuel-based
USE_FUEL.blurb: Models lifetime fuel combustion of sold products.

VEH_DIST.name: Vehicle-distance
VEH_DIST.blurb: Applies a vehicle-kilometre factor where load is unknown.
VEH_DIST.source_ref: Policy and Action Standard Table 8.6, p.87

VOL_WATER.name: Volume-based
VOL_WATER.blurb: Applies supply or treatment factors to metered water volume.

WASTE_TREAT.name: Treatment-specific
WASTE_TREAT.blurb: Applies an average-composition factor for the treatment route.
WASTE_TREAT.source_ref: Policy and Action Standard Table 8.6, p.87

WASTE_TYPE.name: Waste-type-specific
WASTE_TYPE.blurb: Applies a factor resolved from both waste stream and treatment route.
WASTE_TYPE.source_ref: Policy and Action Standard Table 8.6, p.87

WTT_FUEL.name: Upstream fuel (well-to-tank)
WTT_FUEL.blurb: Applies an upstream extraction and refining factor to fuel purchased.

WT_DIST.name: Weight-distance
WT_DIST.blurb: Applies a tonne-kilometre factor to mass moved over distance.
